reason.title: Reason
reason.default: Full billing-period interval demand, ratchets and utility rules are unavailable; no demand-charge savings claimed

identity_notice.title: Identity Notice
identity_notice.default: Local simulation session; not a verified human identity or production role

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.default: SIMULATED gross avoided energy only; constant reduction assumed. Excludes rebound, production costs, demand charges, settlement and verified savings.

method.title: Method
method.default: Prospective rolling-origin evaluation; all 30 future minute bins required

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.default: Mean of five complete 1-minute facility demand bins; flat 30-minute horizon

training.title: Training
training.default: No fitted parameters; prospective chronological evaluation only

target.title: Target
target.default: Per-minute mean facility active power over the next 30 minutes

interpretation.title: Interpretation
interpretation.default: Descriptive comparison of synthetic electricity and operator-declared output; not causal proof, industrial savings or independent quality verification.
